text:
Alyssa Nguyen: Quick heads-up — offer for Marco Ramirez (Sr Infra Eng). Proposed start 2026-05-15. Hiring manager wants PTO split for first month and finance flagged the signing bonus needs a gross-up because it's covering a tax-sensitive relocation allowance. Can we route approvals?

Tony Brooks: @Alyssa can you confirm total signing bonus number and whether gross-up is requested on whole amount or only relocation portion?

Alyssa Nguyen: total signing = $20k, relocation stipend = $8k. Manager asked for gross-up on the $8k only. Requesting comp approval + payroll + benefits sign-off.

Keegan Patel: Payroll here — gross-up ok but need GL code + payroll effective date. Also we prefer a standard accounting reason code: "RELO_GROSSUP_2026". Sample payload we need: 

```
{ "employee": "Marco Ramirez", "start_date": "2026-05-15", "grossup_amount": 8000, "gl_code": "RELO_GROSSUP_2026" }
```

Jess (People Ops): Benefits note — health benefits eligibility is first day of employment if start is within the month; depends on carrier. For 05-15 start, medical start = 2026-05-01 for some carriers (if run monthly), others pro-rate deductions. We can confirm carrier rules but offering to bridge coverage via a small stipend instead of changing plan start.

Marco Ramirez: quick Q — if start gets moved to 05-01 will that change my PTO accrual? Manager mentioned moving earlier to avoid pro-ration.

Alyssa Nguyen: Manager suggested 05-01 as option. That's up to you Marco — we'd need notice to relocation team and recruiter to rebook orientation. Also comp approval needed for effective start earlier.

Tony Brooks: If we move start earlier it may bump Marco into the next pay period for accruals. We can approve earlier start but need leadership sign-off for any change that affects headcount month. @Finance-RX please advise on headcount/cost impact.

Finance-RX: Heads-up — moving start to 05-01 increases current-month run-rate and may push against hiring commit. If the gross-up stays the same, cost delta is minimal but we need sign-off from Finance Director for the month reallocation. Recommend approval path: finance director -> payroll -> people ops.

Keegan Patel: If we keep 05-15 and manager still wants PTO augmented, payroll can frontload 3 days of PTO as a one-time manual credit instead of changing start. That avoids moving start and avoids carrier complications.

Jess (People Ops): Agreed — frontload PTO is simplest. For benefits bridging, we can offer a one-time $300 health bridging stipend if carrier won't start until 06-01. Will confirm carriers and send exact wording for offer letter.

Alyssa Nguyen: Action items: (1) Alyssa to submit comp approval for gross-up on $8k to Tony, (2) Tony to route to Finance Director if moving start date; otherwise approve gross-up + frontload PTO, (3) Keegan to prepare payroll payload once GL code confirmed, (4) Jess to confirm carrier dates and draft offer wording for stipend/frontloaded PTO.

Recruiter-bot: Offer created: offer-7892 for Marco Ramirez. Link: https://recruiter.internal/offers/7892 (status: draft)

Tony Brooks: sounds good. @Alyssa please ping me the comp justification doc and I'll start the route.

Alyssa Nguyen: Will do — sending docs now. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Marco Ramirez: thanks everyone — prefer 05-15 and the PTO frontload option if possible. Appreciate the flexibility!
